# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: IRQ gulf on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | Iraq 1970. Generated by tools/iraq_1970/compile.py.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			IRQ = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
					COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_initialize = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
				COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_daily = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							ROOT = { tag = IRQ }
							FROM = { tag = PER }
						}
						AND = {
							ROOT = { tag = PER }
							FROM = { tag = IRQ }
						}
					}
				}
				IRQ = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_observer = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	on_peaceconference_ended = {
		effect = {
			IRQ = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_war_observer = yes }
		}
	}
	on_declare_war = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
					FROM = { tag = KUW }
				}
				ROOT = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_invaded_kuwait }
				set_global_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_iraq_attacked_kuwait
			}
		}
	}
	on_capitulation_immediate = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { tag = KUW }
					FROM = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
				}
				FROM = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seize_kuwait_treasury = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	on_annex = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_actor = yes }
					FROM = { tag = KUW }
				}
				ROOT = { COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_seize_kuwait_treasury = yes COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_conquest_relief = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
